messages:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sample app just tripped in staging. During a 429 spike the webhook consumer retried and created duplicate invoices. Logs show retries w/o idempotency header. Stack: sampleapp-payments v0.3.2. Repro steps attached.

idan: ack. Can you paste the error snippet + headers we saw? 429 handling should be safe-replay by default, but our sampleapp client doesn't set Idempotency-Key.

maria: log:
```
[2026-03-10T15:22:11Z] POST /charge 429 rate_limit exceeded
headers: {"Authorization": "Bearer xxxxx", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
body: {...}
```
We also saw the SDK retry 3x immediately (no jitter).

ryan: oof. Which SDK? Go/Node/Python?

maria: node SDK used in sampleapp. version 2.1.0

dan: Node SDK should set automatic idempotency for `createPayment` when run in server mode — looks like onboarding sample uses our minimal http wrapper (bypasses SDK). Two things: 1) add Idempotency-Key header; 2) implement exponential backoff with jitter. Example:
```
Idempotency-Key: <uuid4>

retry algo (pseudo):
for attempt in 1..max:
  sleep = base * (2 ** (attempt-1)) * (0.5 + random())
```

sophie: I'll add a small middleware in the sampleapp that injects idempotency for POST /payments and a retry helper. Will open PR today.

ryan: also check SDK parity — the Go SDK added `auto_idempotency=true` flag last month; Node hasn't. We should either add that or ensure sampleapp uses SDK.

maria: thanks. Short-term patch in sampleapp + docs note for onboarding guide about 429+safe replay. Would be good to add a "danger" callout that minimal wrappers bypass SDK protections.

ci-bot: deployment queued: staging/sampleapp v0.3.3 -> running tests

sophie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/58 implements middleware + tests. Manual test steps in description.

dan: once merged, can we add a smoke test that simulates 429 and asserts single side-effect? helps prevent regressions.

maria: yes — will add to onboarding checklist. thanks all :tada:
